subject.title: feat(apple): session search, archived browsing, and sheet management actions

question: Should Android stored operator handoff tokens be allowed or upgraded to `operator.admin` for session model switching, or should model switching require an explicit reauth/narrower gateway authorization path?
rationale: The PR's intended Android model picker needs admin-only `sessions.patch` model updates, but the existing persisted-token path deliberately strips admin and changing that persistence broadens the operator token boundary.

options.title: Require an upgrade-safe auth path before merge
options.body: Choose a secure stored-token upgrade, reauth, or disabled-until-admin path and require tests covering bootstrap handoff, app restart, and model selection.

options.title: Narrow this PR to Apple session management
options.body: Remove or split the Android model-picker/admin-scope changes so the Apple session sheet can proceed without changing the Android token boundary in this branch.

options.title: Accept fresh-only model switching
options.body: Merge knowing QR/setup-code Android users can lose model switching after restart and that persisted token privilege remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Require an upgrade-safe auth path before merge
recommendation.body: Choose a secure stored-token upgrade, reauth, or disabled-until-admin path and require tests covering bootstrap handoff, app restart, and model selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The same owner is carrying the session-management feature and the security-sensitive gateway scope prerequisite, and is identified by the guard as trusted openclaw-secops for this PR.
